name: the report gate narrows below the read gate (backlog #110's own defect)
edits:
if not header or rows:
                continue
expect: wherever a plain row would be READ, a decorated one is REPORTED

name: the unread list is emptied after parse (feature dead, proxies satisfied)
expect: main RUN end to end reports the unread row on the terminal

name: only DEPENDS notes are qualified while a row is unread
edits: if ("no longer open" in n or "is not an open item" in n) else n
if ("is not an open item" in n) else n
expect: a GROUPS note is qualified while something is unread

name: drift notes lose the ⚠ prefix the Refresh button collects
expect: every drift note is marked ⚠, which is what the Refresh button collects

name: a delimiter cell may trail anything (half-typed row swallowed)
expect: a cell that starts like a delimiter and continues is not one

name: only the first `(tag)` group of a cell is read, so a two-tag row loses its second tag
expect: a cell with TWO tags assigns both, in cell order

name: a comma between groups stops being a separator
expect: a comma between groups separates them exactly as a space does

name: a tag is no longer lowercased or space-collapsed, so two spellings stay two tags
expect: a tag is normalised — case, runs of space, spaces around the slash

name: two spellings of one tag in one cell are both kept
expect: two spellings of one tag in one cell are ONE tag, not two

name: a malformed cell is DROPPED instead of read as one tag
expect: a malformed cell is read as ONE tag and flagged, never dropped

name: the malformed-cell note never reaches the drift box
expect: drift_notes_for carries the malformed-cell note

name: the FIRST claiming area wins instead of the nearest, so a money row lands under the `cloud` node
expect: the nearest claiming area wins, and an unclaimed leaf falls to its family

name: a bare prefix counts as a family, so `cloudy` is claimed by `cloud`
expect: the nearest claiming area wins, and an unclaimed leaf falls to its family

name: the filter tags take only the first leaf, so a two-tag row is counted under one tag
expect: the filter lists a two-tag row under EACH of its tags, counts derived per tag

name: a card draws only its last tag's chip again
expect: a two-tag card draws a chip per tag and carries every filter tag

name: a `|` inside a tag group is accepted again, so the filter offers a tag that matches nothing
expect: a `|` inside a tag group, escaped or not, is MALFORMED

name: the header schema check is dropped, so a misspelled Bundle column parses with every tag empty
expect: a six-column table whose header misspells Bundle REFUSES, naming the table

name: the header schema check is LOOSENED to width only, so `Bundel` passes

name: the block-header check is dropped, so a table headed `| No |`, or none, hides its rows again
expect: a table headed `| No |` REFUSES — the r4 probe

name: an undeclared non-`#` header is accepted as a legend, so `| No |` passes
edits:
if cells in LEGEND_SCHEMAS:
        return None
expect: a table headed `| No |` REFUSES — the r4 probe

name: an empty tag group `()` is dropped in silence again, so master's gate is red and this one green
expect: an EMPTY group is MALFORMED, and the cell's other tags survive it
